task_selection: first two task ids after sorting within each heldout database family; no task or trace from heldout families may enter mining

replay.candidate_policy: one SELECT or WITH statement; no shell, writes, multiple statements, or hidden gold access
replay.verdict: strict ordered columns and multiplicity plus unordered diagnostic
replay.independent_evaluator: bird_sql_trace_replay.py semantics, with gold sidecars sealed from the proposer

controls.formatting_placebo: same task and schema plus output-format instruction only
controls.trace_mined_procedure: procedure generated only from evidence-family traces and frozen before heldout calls

promotion.powered_gate: not satisfied by this six-task pilot; require at least 20 heldout tasks across four families with paired confidence intervals
